prompts.text: If we invented a silly award for our best shared habit, what would we call it?
Tell me about a moment we both started laughing and couldn't explain why.
Recreate our funniest date memory or invent a completely new tradition?
Our everyday life becomes a comedy series. Which ordinary event deserves the opening scene?
Couples build their own humour from details other people hardly notice.
A good inside joke is more useful than an expensive surprise on a difficult day.
What's a tiny expression of mine you would imitate if you knew I wouldn't be offended?
Recall a harmless misunderstanding between us that became a favourite joke.
We're asked to write a description of each other using only three funny clues. What are yours?
A shared ridiculous nickname or a secret greeting nobody else understands?
Which small household task would become more fun if we made it a game?
Describe a time we turned an everyday inconvenience into something worth remembering.
Race to fold laundry or compete to find the most efficient way to organise a drawer?
We have twenty minutes to tidy a room before guests arrive. What's our imaginary team name?
The person who treats chores like a game often makes the work feel shorter.
Sharing a chore can be fun even when neither person is especially good at it.
What job around the house would you nominate for our weekly comedy challenge?
Tell me about a time one of us confidently tried a shortcut that didn't work.
The washing machine gives us feedback on our teamwork. What's its biggest complaint?
Cook with a timer and silly rules or clean while taking turns choosing songs?
What's an unexpected theme you'd choose for our next home date?
Tell me about an outing we improvised because our original plans changed.
A living-room picnic or a dinner where we each prepare a mystery course?
We decide our next date must cost almost nothing. What three things would you plan?
The funniest dates sometimes begin with very ordinary decisions.
A two-person adventure doesn't have to involve travelling far.
Which small public event would you enjoy visiting together purely out of curiosity?
Recall the strangest place we found an unexpectedly good conversation.
Our date is interrupted by a sudden downpour. How would you turn the afternoon around?
A board-game café with friendly competition or a quiet gallery where we invent stories about paintings?
What's the funniest food opinion we disagree about?
Describe a time we ordered very different meals and both ended up wanting the other's.
Choose ingredients for each other's sandwiches or compete to invent the best simple dessert?
We're asked to create a restaurant dish based on our personalities. What would we call it?
Food preferences become a source of humour when people learn each other's unusual combinations.
Sharing the last bite is a bigger relationship negotiation than people admit.
Which snack do you think I would secretly steal from your plate?
Tell me about an attempt to surprise each other with food that went slightly wrong.
We have to prepare breakfast using ingredients selected by a random draw. What should we hope to pick?
A playful cooking competition or a taste test of unfamiliar snacks?
Which song would you choose as the soundtrack to one of our funniest shared moments?
Tell me about a tune that instantly reminds you of an ordinary day together.
Make a playlist of our silly memories or exchange songs that match each other's moods?
We have to perform a harmless duet at a party. Which kind of song would save us?
A couple's shared playlist often contains songs neither person expected to love.
Terrible singing together is more fun than one person putting on a perfect performance.
What's one musical habit of mine you would gently tease me about?
Recall the first time we realised we knew all the words to the same song.
We each get to choose the other's entrance music for one day. What's your choice for me?
A surprise dance in the kitchen or a quiet listening session with one new album?
What's the most playful way you'd remind me of something important?
Describe a time one of us rescued the other from a minor embarrassing situation.
Leave a funny sticky note on the fridge or send a gentle reminder with an absurd picture?
We have to invent a secret signal for when it's time to leave a party. What would work?
People learn each other's social limits partly through watching their expressions.
Knowing when your partner wants to go home is more impressive than winning every party game.
Which expression of mine tells you I'm about to laugh even when I'm trying not to?
Recall noticing I was uncomfortable and finding a kind way to change the subject.
We're both trying not to laugh during a very ordinary formal event. What's our plan?
A discreet code word or one raised eyebrow as our signal?
What's a harmless challenge we should attempt together purely for the story?
Tell me about trying something new together when neither of us had much skill.
A beginner pottery class or a partner dance lesson with no audience?
We join a quiz contest with questions about each other's habits. Which round worries you most?
Couples sometimes find their different strengths useful in the most unexpected situations.
Trying a new hobby together is worthwhile even if both people abandon it after one afternoon.
Which of our skills would make us an unexpectedly good team in a game?
Describe a time we solved a problem by combining two very different ideas.
We're entering a friendly two-person competition tomorrow. What should we practise tonight?
Team up against another pair or challenge each other and compare results afterwards?
What's a silly tradition we'd still enjoy after several years together?
Recall an anniversary detail we laughed about more than the official celebration.
Exchange homemade awards once a year or revisit our first favourite outing?
We invent a new holiday dedicated to appreciating small acts of care. What's its name?
A relationship's happiest traditions don't always require a calendar date.
A playful tradition is worth keeping only while both people continue to enjoy it.
Which old photo of us would make the funniest annual recreation?
Tell me about a funny coincidence we experienced on an important date.
We want to celebrate a milestone while travelling on a tight schedule. What's one playful gesture?
Hide a short note for the other person or organise a tiny surprise scavenger hunt?
When have I made you laugh while you were trying to look serious?
Tell me about a time we handled a stressful day better because we could joke together.
Cheer each other on with ridiculous team slogans or exchange encouraging mini letters?
We've both had difficult days and have fifteen free minutes. What's a playful reset we could try?
A gentle joke can show closeness when it doesn't dismiss the other person's feelings.
Knowing when not to joke is as important as being funny.
What's a kind way we could lighten each other's mood without forcing a smile?
Recall helping each other through a mistake without turning it into blame.
One of us wants quiet while the other wants to cheer them up. How would we find a comfortable middle ground?
A short walk and a silly story or an evening in with familiar comfort food?
What's an ordinary experience you'd want us to look back on and laugh about later?
Describe a moment when one of us changed a plan and the outcome surprised us.
Collect funny notes about our year or take a photograph of one ordinary moment each month?
Our future selves send us a single piece of playful relationship advice. What might it say?
Couples often remember their own small jokes more vividly than expensive occasions.
A good relationship leaves room for being silly without trying to impress anybody.
Which spontaneous activity would you enjoy adding to an otherwise predictable weekend?
Recall a quiet day that unexpectedly became one of our favourite memories.
We're each given a blank card to plan the other's next free afternoon. What's the first thing you'd write?
End the day with one funny story or begin the morning with a playful question?
